title: ELIXIR - Single Cell Omics Benchmark - FAIR Metadata
description:
FAIR metadata, query tool and web portal for the benchmark experiment 1 (BE1) of the ELIXIR Single Cell Omics community: a 10x Genomics single-cell RNA-seq experiment with seven lung cancer cell lines carrying different driver alterations (EGFR, KRAS, MET, BRAF, ERBB2, ROS1, ALK) and a peripheral blood mononuclear cell population (GEO series GSE243665; 29,128 cells from the cell lines and 478 peripheral blood mononuclear cells).

The experiment is described with the Single Cell Schema version 0.4 (scrna-schema/) and linked to the public records of GEO, SRA, BioProject and figshare. The count data are not part of this repository; they are available from GEO and figshare.

The experiment was published by Arigoni et al. (2024, Scientific Data 11:159, doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03002-y). Please cite the original publication as well as this package.
references: Arigoni M, Ratto ML, Riccardo F, Balmas E, Calogero L, Cordero F, Beccuti M, Calogero RA, Alessandri L. A single cell RNAseq benchmark experiment embedding "controlled" cancer heterogeneity. Sci Data 2024;11:159. doi:10.1038/s41597-024-03002-y
